prompt: Can you write me an email telling my boss that I will be out because I am going on a vacation that was planned months ago?
response:
Subject: Vacation Planned Months Ago

Dear [Boss's Name],

I hope this email finds you well. I am writing to inform you that I will be taking a leave of absence from [start date] to [end date] because I had planned a vacation months ago. I understand if this causes any inconvenience and will ensure that all my work is up to date before I leave. I will be checking my emails occasionally, so feel free to reach out if there's an emergency. I look forward to returning refreshed and ready to work.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
